allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When news of John Smith's death reaches America, Pocahontas is devastated. She sets off to London with John Rolfe, to meet with the King of England on a diplomatic mission: to create peace and respect between the two great lands. However, Governor Ratcliffe is still around; he wants to return to Jamestown and take over. He will stop at nothing to discredit the young princess.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With Governor Ratcliffe plotting to humiliate her before the English court, can Pocahontas secure peace before his schemes prevail?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Grieving the reported death of John Smith, Pocahontas travels to London alongside John Rolfe on a royal peace mission, only to face Governor Ratcliffe's ruthless plot to sabotage her standing with the King.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: An easy-watching, moderately emotional animated adventure with steady pace and lively court intrigue.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Running a swift 72 minutes, this animated adventure blends royal intrigue and romantic drama into a spirited, accessible family journey across the Atlantic.
